_note: Actual AA pilot hourly rates from the 2023 CBA, Effective 1/1/2026 (current). $/flight-hour by year-of-service (index 0 = year 1 ... index 11 = year 12+). 320/737 use the standard narrowbody tier (A320/B737 family); 787/777 use the widebody tier. Income = rate * config.annual_hours; config.annual_raise_pct compounds rates forward from 2026 for future contract raises (the 1/1/2027 table is ~+3%). Employer adds 18% of income (non-elective); there is no separate match.
